methods.label: Compare the times for one mile
methods.explanation:
The question asks about time for one mile, so divide each total time by the number of miles. First put both times in minutes.

As a boy, Cheenu took \(3\cdot60+30=210\) minutes for \(15\) miles. His time per mile was
\[
210\div15=14\text{ minutes}.
\]
Now he takes \(4\cdot60=240\) minutes for \(10\) miles, giving
\[
240\div10=24\text{ minutes per mile}.
\]
The increase is \(24-14=10\) minutes, choice B.
